entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm sensing Shadows. Lots of them.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's to be expected... We're basically[n]raiding her tomb, after all.
entries.uk: Воно й не дивно... Ми ж, по суті,[n]грабуємо її гробницю.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'd better be cautious as we go,[n]you guys!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.uk: Отже, ви прийшли. Ідіть за мною.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit! Is she tryin' to kill us[n]or something!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, look. There's some light up above.[n]It's another one of those reflective boards.
entries.uk: Стривайте, гляньте. Нагорі світло.[n]Це ще одна така дзеркальна плита.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, but unless we can do something[n]about this trap, we will not be able to[n]proceed.
entries.uk: Так, але поки ми не зарадимо цій[n]пастці, далі нам не пройти.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, what a pain in the ass!
